title: Move agent file tools onto the computer-capable host
description:
**Step 3 of the accepted `chatticus-fccc4e9a` host-disk plan.** Steps 1 (`chatticus-4ac60c71`) and 2 (`chatticus-47533582` / PR #321) are closed.

Move agent file tools off the in-process `computer.workspace` dict and onto the summoned computer-capable host (a workspace executor beside `ChromiumActionExecutor`). One path: do not leave the dict readable beside host disk.

Gherkin, worker, Front Door HTTP. Host is `HttpWorkerPlane` only. File bytes live on `ComputerHostDisk`; ThinTurn recycle must not drop them from the agent-visible path.

**Not this slice:** customer snapshot bucket / `customer-role.yml` (`chatticus-bb908488` is step 4). Gherkin may use `FilesystemSnapshotStore`. No `/workspace` EFS. No prompt tuning.

## Done when

Agent file read/write is specified in Gherkin against host disk (not the dict), green through the Front Door host path. `ControlPlane.read_workspace` / `write_workspace` are no longer the agent-visible workplace. No `customer-role.yml` edit.

comments.text: Composer 2.5 planning. Worktree to be named `/tmp/chatticus-5ac06b-file-tools-host` on `feat/5ac06b-file-tools-on-host`. Implementation not authorized until the plan is reviewed. Do not mix `chatticus-bb9084` (snapshot bucket / customer-role.yml) into this slice. Host remains Front Door HTTP only.
